process_area.title: Hard & Soft FM Service Operations (Cleaning, Pest, Security, Grounds, Workplace)

value_stream.name: Integrated Facilities Management, Workplace Services & Building Automation

fields.Participants: Site staff (VS-07/VS-04), Provider workforce (VS-98), HSE (VS-24), Store Ops
fields.Trigger: Daily/periodic schedule; special clean (post-typhoon, spill, event)
fields.Volume: ~205 sites × daily cleaning (selling floor, restrooms, backroom, yards, HQ offices)

Automation Opportunity: - Checklist/photo-evidence mobile app; consumables auto-replenishment alerts
Controls: - CTL-645 (ensure controlled execution — Hard & Soft FM Service Operations (Cleaning, Pest, Security, Grounds, Workplace) (PA-138.2).)
- CTL-645 (cleaning checklist with verification; cleaning-chemical SDS/PPE (VS-24.3/VS-114))
Cross-references: - links to VS-07.2 (consumables/store equipment), VS-98 (provider workforce), VS-24.3 (chemical safety), VS-114 (SDS), VS-13 (customer experience), VS-69 (post-typhoon clean)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Customer-experience risk**: Dirty store/restroom harms experience (links VS-13); mitigated by checklist + verification
- **Chemical-safety risk**: Cleaning-chemical handling (some DG) → health/exposure; mitigated by SDS (VS-114/VS-24.3) and PPE
System Touchpoints: - CAFM cleaning schedule/checklist; consumables inventory (VS-07.2); provider workforce (VS-98); work-orders (W4174)
Time Estimate: - Daily per site; cleaning labor ~national provider force

steps.activity: Facilities/Provider execute the daily cleaning schedule per site-type standard (floor, restrooms, glass, backroom, yard) with checklists and photo evidence, resourced by the provider workforce (VS-98)
Facilities schedule periodic deep cleans (floor stripping/waxing, high-level dusting, facade) and special cleans (post-typhoon VS-69, spill/biohazard, post-event), coordinating with site operations
Facilities/Provider stock cleaning consumables, manage hygiene supplies (restroom, sanitizing stations), verify quality with the site, and report cleaning SLA (W4171/W4176)

fields.Owner: Facilities Soft-Services Lead / Licensed Pest-Control Provider
fields.Volume: ~205 sites (tropical pest pressure: rodents, termites, cockroaches, mosquitoes)

Automation Opportunity: - Sighting-report mobile logging; infestation-trend analytics; application-record automation
Controls: - CTL-645: FPA-licensed applicator; pesticide SDS/application records (VS-24.3/VS-114); audit-ready
Cross-references: - links to VS-24.3 (chemical safety), VS-114 (SDS), VS-07 (store), VS-04 (DC), W4172 (termite/structural), W4182 (cafeteria pest)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Infestation risk**: Pests in a hardware/garden-assortment store harm goods/customers; mitigated by preventive cycle
- **Chemical-misuse risk**: Unlicensed/over-application → health/regulatory exposure; mitigated by licensed provider + SDS/records
System Touchpoints: - CAFM pest schedule/records; chemical SDS (VS-114); HSE (VS-24.3); work-orders (W4174); condition (W4172)
Time Estimate: - Per cycle per site; reactive as-reported

steps.activity: Facilities/Provider run the preventive pest-control cycle (inspection, baiting/trapping, treatment) by a licensed provider (FPA-licensed pesticide applicator), per site standard
Site staff report sightings (rodent, termite, insect) via helpdesk (W4174); provider responds reactively, escalating structural risk (termites links to W4172 condition)
Facilities/Provider manage pesticide chemical safety (SDS, application records, re-entry intervals links to VS-24.3/VS-114), document for audit, and monitor infestation trends (W4192 analytics)

fields.Participants: Guarding Provider (VS-98), LP (VS-23.2), Store Ops (VS-07), Cash-in-Transit (VS-81)
fields.Trigger: Contract cycle; site opening (VS-37); security-incident response

workflows.name: Security Guarding Service Coordination & Site Protection

Automation Opportunity: - Guard-attendance/tour-point scanning; incident-report mobile app; post-manning dashboards
Controls: - CTL-645 (ensure controlled execution — Hard & Soft FM Service Operations (Cleaning, Pest, Security, Grounds, Workplace) (PA-138.2).)
- CTL-645: guards licensed/compliance-checked; guarding-vs-LP RACI documented (VS-23); incident reporting
Cross-references: - links to VS-23.1 (LP investigations), VS-23.2 (surveillance/access), VS-98 (guarding workforce), VS-81 (cash-in-transit), VS-24.2 (emergency), VS-37 (new-site guarding)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Undermanning risk**: Guard no-shows leave sites exposed; mitigated by provider attendance SLA
- **Boundary-confusion risk**: Guarding (Facilities) vs surveillance/investigation (LP); mitigated by clear RACI with VS-23
System Touchpoints: - Guarding contract/workforce (VS-98); LP surveillance/access (VS-23.2); incident mgmt (VS-23.1); cash-in-transit (VS-81); emergency (VS-24.2)

steps.activity: Facilities/LP coordinate the guarding-service contract (post-manning, shifts, arming/batons per policy, licensing/SOB/SSS compliance) resourced by the provider (VS-98), distinct from LP surveillance (VS-23.2)
Guards execute posts (entrance control, patrol, after-hours watch, cash-pickup coordination links to VS-81), reporting incidents to LP/helpdesk (VS-23.1/W4174)
Facilities/LP manage guard performance (attendance, incident response), licensing/compliance, and coordinate with LP investigations (VS-23.1) and emergency response (VS-24.2)

fields.Participants: Site staff (VS-07), Provider, Engineering (VS-20.2), Real Estate (VS-97)
fields.Trigger: Scheduled cycle; storm damage; exterior defect report
fields.Volume: ~205 sites × exterior/grounds (parking, yard, signage, facade, perimeter)

Automation Opportunity: - Exterior-condition photo logging; storm-recovery checklist automation
Controls: - CTL-645 (ensure controlled execution — Hard & Soft FM Service Operations (Cleaning, Pest, Security, Grounds, Workplace) (PA-138.2).)
- CTL-645 (exterior/grounds standard with verification; storm-recovery procedure (VS-69))
Cross-references: - links to VS-69 (typhoon/storm recovery), VS-20.2 (engineering), VS-97 (real estate), VS-14 (brand/signage), W4172 (condition), VS-40 (capex)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Drainage/storm risk**: Clogged drains/poor grounds → flooding in typhoons; mitigated by periodic clearing + post-storm recovery
- **Curb-appeal risk**: Neglected exterior/signage harms brand (links VS-14); mitigated by exterior standard
System Touchpoints: - CAFM exterior/grounds schedule; work-orders (W4174); condition (W4172); capex (VS-40); disaster response (VS-69)

steps.activity: Facilities/Provider maintain grounds and exterior — parking-lot sweeping/line-marking, landscaping/trimming, drainage clearing, signage/facade condition — per site standard
Facilities/Engineering handle exterior fabric defects (roof leak, facade, perimeter fence, signage damage — links to W4172 condition) via work-orders (W4174), escalating to capex (VS-40) where needed
Facilities coordinate post-storm exterior recovery (debris, drainage, signage — links to VS-69), and monitor exterior condition trends (W4192 analytics)

fields.Participants: Site staff (VS-07/VS-04), Waste hauler (VS-73), Utility providers, HSE (VS-24.3)
fields.Trigger: Daily waste cycle; utility billing; recycling/hazardous-waste event

workflows.name: Waste, Recycling & Utilities Coordination at Site

Controls: - CTL-645 (ensure controlled execution — Hard & Soft FM Service Operations (Cleaning, Pest, Security, Grounds, Workplace) (PA-138.2).)
- CTL-645 (hazwaste licensed transport + manifest (VS-73.2/VS-114); utility consumption monitored (VS-120))
Cross-references: - links to VS-73 (waste), VS-73.2 (hazwaste/DENR), VS-114 (DG manifest), VS-07.1 W111 (utilities), VS-120 (energy), VS-24.2 (utility outage)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Hazwaste-risk**: Improper disposal of DG/e-waste → DENR/liability exposure; mitigated by licensed transport + manifest (VS-73.2/VS-114)
- **Utility-cost risk**: Unmonitored usage/waste leaks cost; mitigated by consumption monitoring (VS-120)
System Touchpoints: - Waste program (VS-73); hazardous-waste manifest (VS-114); utility billing (VS-07.1 W111); energy monitoring (VS-120); emergency (VS-24.2)
Time Estimate: - Daily waste; monthly utilities; ongoing site-team coordination

steps.activity: Facilities/Site coordinate daily waste segregation & hauler pickup (general, recyclable, cardboard) at each site, aligned to the store-waste program (VS-73.1)
steps.r: Facilities Site Coord / Site Staff / Waste Hauler

steps.activity: Facilities/Site coordinate hazardous-waste handling (used paint, solvents, batteries, e-waste — links to VS-73.2 DENR) with licensed transporters (VS-114 manifest), per regulation
steps.r: Facilities Site Coord / HSE / Hazwaste Transporter

steps.activity: Facilities/Energy coordinate site utility accounts (electricity, water — billing links to VS-07.1 W111), consumption monitoring (VS-120), and outage/response (links to VS-24.2/VS-69)

fields.Participants: Catering Vendor, Wellness (VS-83), HSE (VS-24), HR (VS-19), Finance (VS-34.3)
fields.Trigger: Service setup; vendor cycle; employee-feedback review
fields.Volume: HQ (~362 staff) + DC canteens; store break-rooms

workflows.name: Workplace Services — Cafeteria, Canteen & Employee Amenities

Controls: - CTL-645 (ensure controlled execution — Hard & Soft FM Service Operations (Cleaning, Pest, Security, Grounds, Workplace) (PA-138.2).)
Cross-references: - links to VS-83 (wellness), VS-103.2 (employee experience), VS-24 (food safety), VS-34.2/VS-34.3 (vendor/expense), W4177 (sanitation), W4178 (canteen pest)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Food-safety risk**: Foodborne illness at canteen → health/liability; mitigated by licensed vendor + sanitation
- **Satisfaction risk**: Poor amenities harm EX/retention (links VS-103.2); mitigated by feedback loop
System Touchpoints: - Catering contract (VS-34.2); HSE/food-safety (VS-24); wellness (VS-83); employee experience (VS-103.2); expense (VS-34.3)

steps.activity: Facilities manage the cafeteria/canteen concession (vendor selection, food-safety licensing, pricing, subsidy policy) and employee amenities (lockers, break-rooms, prayer/feeding rooms) at HQ/DCs
Facilities/Catering ensure food safety & hygiene (FDA/food-handler permits, sanitation links to W4177, pest control W4178) and coordinate with wellness (VS-83) on healthy options
Facilities/HR gather employee feedback (links to VS-103.2 EX), manage vendor performance/cost, and report amenity satisfaction (W4192 analytics)

Controls: - CTL-645 (ensure controlled execution — Hard & Soft FM Service Operations (Cleaning, Pest, Security, Grounds, Workplace) (PA-138.2).)
- CTL-645 (chain-of-custody for documents/records (VS-88); confidentiality for sensitive mail (VS-91))
Cross-references: - links to VS-88 (records), VS-91 (confidentiality), VS-34.2 (courier vendor), VS-99 (IT logistics), VS-133 (process improvement)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Loss/confidentiality risk**: Mail/records lost or exposed; mitigated by chain-of-custody and secure handling (VS-88/VS-91)
- **Inefficiency risk**: Manual sort/dispatch; mitigated by process improvement (VS-133)
System Touchpoints: - Courier contracts (VS-34.2); records transit (VS-88); IT logistics (VS-99)

steps.activity: Mailroom handle inbound/outbound mail and parcels at HQ (sort, distribute, dispatch via courier), and inter-site document movement
Mailroom coordinate with Records (VS-88) for document/records transit and retention-box movement, and with IT (VS-99) for equipment logistics
Facilities manage courier vendor performance/cost (links to VS-34.2), track service levels, and report mailroom efficiency (W4192 analytics)

fields.Participants: Trades contractors, Engineering (VS-20.2), HSE (VS-24), Store Ops (VS-07)
fields.Trigger: PM schedule (W4173); reactive fault (W4174); compliance test
fields.Volume: ~205 sites × building systems (HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire, elevators, generators)

workflows.name: Hard FM Trades — HVAC, Electrical, Plumbing & Fire Systems Service

Automation Opportunity: - PM auto-scheduling; work-order mobile dispatch; IoT fault-detection on critical systems (W4185)
Controls: - CTL-645 (ensure controlled execution — Hard & Soft FM Service Operations (Cleaning, Pest, Security, Grounds, Workplace) (PA-138.2).)
- CTL-645 (trades licensed/certified (electrical/fire/elevator); PM completion + compliance tracked (VS-24/VS-22))
Cross-references: - links to W4173 (PM), W4174 (reactive), W4172 (condition), VS-20.3 (equipment — boundary), VS-24.2 (emergency), VS-22 (fire-code), VS-40 (capex)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Competence/licensing risk**: Unlicensed electrical/fire/elevator work → safety/liability; mitigated by licensed-contractor requirement
- **System-failure risk**: AC/elevator/power failure closes operations; mitigated by PM + rapid reactive SLA
System Touchpoints: - CAFM PM/work-orders (W4173/W4174); HSE (VS-24); engineering (VS-20.2); condition/capex (W4172/VS-40); emergency (VS-24.2)
Time Estimate: - Continuous PM + reactive; trades labor national

steps.activity: Trades execute PM on building systems (HVAC service, electrical inspection, plumbing, fire-system test, generator load-test, elevator service — W4173), documenting completion/findings
Trades respond to reactive faults via work-orders (W4174) — AC failure, power, leak, elevator trap — within SLA, coordinating with site operations and emergency response (VS-24.2)
Facilities manage trades-contractor competence/licensing (electrical, fire-system, elevator cert), compliance, and feed major findings into capex/condition (W4172/VS-40)
